typography.instruction: Avoid Inter or generic sans fonts for headings. Use fluid scaling for headings up to text-6xl. Use variable font weights like font-light or font-black to break standard bold.

colors.instruction: Do NOT use pure #000000. Use tinted deep slate (#0A0B0E). Avoid generic purple/teal gradients. Primary CTA should use the cinematic amber/gold (#FFB000).

layout_and_spacing.instruction: Use Bento Grid protocol (Mode B for Control Room / Dashboard). Every widget must stretch. Use generous spacing. Cards must have internal padding. Use optical alignment.

surface_strategies.cards: Flat background (bg-white/5), 1px subtle border (border-white/10), no shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
surface_strategies.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: bg-[#0A0B0E]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10.
surface_strategies.video_player_container: Grid borders (Technical look) exposing the skeleton. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for custom layouts, no rigid Shadcn Cards for video players.

components_instructions.forms_and_inputs: Use customized Shadcn Input, Select, Form. Strip default Vercel look. Inputs should have bg-white/5 border-white/10 focus:border-[#FFB000] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#FFB000].
components_instructions.buttons: CTAs must use cinematic amber. Secondary buttons should use transparent background with border-white/20 and hover:bg-white/5.
components_instructions.tables_lists: Go cardless and dense for the projects list.
components_instructions.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight for high-end cinematic feel).

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must have hover states (e.g., hover:text-white). Focus states must have higher contrast.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use subtle glowing gradient line (Tracing Beam) on cards or progress bars. ASCII art or minimal spinners for loaders.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific transition properties like 'transition-transform duration-200 ease-out'.

login_hero_image.description: Cinematic film clapperboard on an outdoor set, ideal for login page background overlay.
login_hero_image.usage: Use as a background in the Login/Register page with a heavy dark overlay (bg-[#0A0B0E]/80).

dashboard_audio_waveform.description: Close-up of an audio editing software interface showing sound wave patterns.
dashboard_audio_waveform.usage: Use as a subtle atmospheric background in empty states or processing status widgets.

testing.instruction: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (kebab-case, role-based). e.g., data-testid='upload-video-button'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts (@fontsource/outfit, @fontsource/manrope) and icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react).
Implement the authentication page using the login_hero_image as a cinematic background with a heavy dark overlay.
Build a Left Sidebar navigation (Projects, Voices, Settings) using the Crystal Glass surface strategy.
Create the Dashboard using Bento Grid. Include a dropzone for video uploads or pasting YouTube URLs.
Design the Project Processing status with an active 'Tracing Beam' effect on the card to indicate progress (uploading -> extracting -> translating -> muxing).
Implement the side-by-side Video Player view for reviewing the original vs dubbed Italian video.
Add a Transcript view using dense, technical grid layout.
Ensure all forms (Settings for TTS voice, speed) use customized Shadcn components with the specified cinematic dark theme.
Do not use generic blue/purple gradients. Stick strictly to the Obsidian (#0A0B0E) and Amber (#FFB000) palette.
Apply data-testid to every button, form input, and key link.
